name: Maria Mason Saotome
original_name: マリア・メイスン・早乙女
source:
Older of Saotome sisters. Maria is a half-blood loli with a G-cup. Very knowledgeable but shy girl with an innocent charm that would ease a soul of any lonely and frustrated person. She is smart, but her reflexes aren't good and she likes to stay indoors.

Maria likes cute things and clothes with frills, which give her a very girlish appearance. She is glad that a private tutor has been found for her, because she doesn't want to be a burden on her busy mother.

She also keeps at secret that since arriving in Japan she's has a "cumming-illness".
